svg.title: An event and its later depiction
svg.desc: The Basi Revolt occurred in 1807. The National Museum dates the fourteen paintings attributed to Esteban Pichay Villanueva to 1821. The timeline is a modern teaching model, not a reproduction of the artworks or a complete chronology.

g.text: A Painting Has Its Own Date
Modern teaching timeline / Not an original artwork
A represented event and the making of an image
Ask who made the work, when, and what viewpoint it presents.
